title: Bano ka Tha Bayan Meri Bachi Guzargayi
body:
Bano ka tha bayan meri bachi guzargayi
Godi mein maa ke hichkiya le le ke margayi
1. Shashmah e be zuban Ali asgher ko roo chuki
Hum shakhle mustafa Ali akber ko roo chuki
Abbas e naamdar ko Sarwar ko roo chuki
Zindaan me rote rote Sakina guzargayi
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Is kamsini mein daagh e yatimi uthayi hai
Baba ke ghame me khoon ke aansoo bahaye hai
Har zulm seh ke Shaam ke zindaan me aayi hai
Sadme utha utha ke Sakina guzargayi
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Sajjad ashk baar hai Zainab hai soughwaar
Marqad me roo he Fatima zehra hai beqarar
Bano tadap ke kehti hai zindaan me baar baar
Seene pe soone wali Sakina guzar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sumhre layee'n ke zulm o sitam wa musibata
Nanne se dil pe ranjo alam wa musibata
Mayyat pe ro rahe hai haram wa musibata
Dunya se aye Kaleem Sakina guzar gaya
Azz...khaiser Kaleem
